map.IPA 有什么用？: What Is the IPA Used For?
map.用一套符号精确标任何语言发音，词典里的 /.../ 即音标；比拼写法更准反映实际: It is a single set of symbols that transcribes the pronunciation of any language precisely. The /.../ in a dictionary entry is phonetic transcription, and it reflects actual pronunciation far better than spelling does.
map.英式美式音标差很多？: Do British and American IPA Differ a Lot?
map.音系不同（如美式卷舌 r、字母读音差异），但共用 IPA；查词典注意标的是英音(: The phonetic systems differ (for example the American rhotic r and letter pronunciation differences), but both share the IPA. When checking a dictionary, look at whether it is transcribed in British English (RP) or American English (GA).
